title: Scan actions
idea: Scan actions: Trusted resource identity precedes a short action list
audience: People who need to contact within a mobile surface.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic signal layout through its contact priority and explicit commitment contract: Never report connected before media connects
navigation: Scan actions keeps the current contact context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Trusted resource identity precedes a short action list
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to contact; visitors need immediate private contact
composition.priority: Never report connected before media connects

imagery.role: Support the actual contact context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Urgent and ordinary actions remain distinct on short screens
Respect safe areas, native text scaling, keyboard intrusion and platform back behavior.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the scan actions structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no contact content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Never report connected before media connects
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized contact content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Never report connected before media connects
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active contact context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure on target devices; test interrupted/resumed state and low-memory restoration.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
